description: A race result is a component part of the race it was run in; an entry has no meaning apart from that race.
A race is a component part of the championship season it belongs to; the season is the whole that the calendar composes.

connection_condition: lapTimes shares raceId and driverId with results
description: A lap is a component part of one car and driver entry in a race.

connection_condition: pitStops shares raceId and driverId with results
description: A pit stop is a component part of one car and driver entry in a race.
A qualifying entry is a component part of the race weekend it belongs to.
A driver standing snapshot is attached to the race after which it was taken and has no meaning outside that race context.
A constructor standing snapshot is attached to the race after which it was taken and has no meaning outside that race context.
A race entry records the participation of one driver, who is not a component part of the entry but its subject.
A race entry credits the constructor whose car was raced, alongside the driver.

connection_condition: races.circuitId corresponds to circuits.circuitId, and the reference is not always resolvable
description: A race is held at a circuit venue. The link is a location reference rather than a type relation, and races can exist whose circuit record is absent.
Each race entry carries exactly one outcome status describing how the entry ended.
Retirement is a kind of race entry status: the statuses that denote a retirement form a proper subset of the statuses a race entry can take.
A win is the classification order of an entry being first in its race, derived from the classification order rather than from the raw finishing position.
A podium finish is a top-three classification order; a win is the special case at the top of that range.
Pole position is the qualifying position of an entry being first.

connection_condition: the within-race fastest-lap rank equals 1, which orders entries by their quickest lap time
description: The fastest lap of a race is the minimum lap time among the entries of that race.

connection_condition: constructorResults shares raceId and constructorId with results
description: Constructor race points are an aggregation of the points credited to that constructor's drivers in the race, subject to the scoring rules of the season in force.
A driver's full name is formed by joining the recorded given name and family name.

connection_condition: drivers.driverRef and drivers.code identify the same drivers as drivers.driverId
description: The reference string and the short code express the same driver identity as the numeric surrogate key, and are alternative ways to locate the same driver.

connection_condition: two entries of the same race share a driverId, or share a positionOrder
description: A shared drive is a property of race entries: one car credited to more than one driver in the same race.

connection_condition: results.number and drivers.number both describe a car number for a driver
description: The car number carried in a race is associated with a driver but is not a stable driver identity, since it is assigned per entry and differs from the driver's registered number.
A driver carries a sporting nationality recorded as a country name string rather than as a reference to a country entity.
A constructor carries a sporting nationality recorded as a country name string rather than as a reference to a country entity.
A circuit carries the country of its physical location, recorded as a name string.
A driver standing describes the championship position of one driver.
A constructor standing describes the championship position of one constructor.

connection_condition: results.grid and qualifying.position for the same race and driver coincide in most but not all entries
description: The starting grid is usually set by the qualifying position but can be altered afterwards, so the two are related rather than equivalent.

connection_condition: results.position and results.positionOrder describe the same entry, but positionOrder is defined for every entry while position is absent for non-classified ones
description: The classified finishing position is a restricted view of the classification order, which additionally ranks the entries that were not classified.

connection_condition: results.grid and qualifying.position relate an entry's pole with the same entry's classification order
description: Pole position and a win are analytically paired when studying whether front-of-grid starts convert into victories, but neither is derived from the other.
